channel.title: Weekend DIY
channel.description: Home repair and improvement projects, planned with real numbers.

item.title: How to Seal Drafty Windows and Doors, Caulk vs Weatherstripping
item.description: Department of Energy guidance on when to use caulk and when to use weatherstripping, how much to buy, and how to apply each for a draft-free fall.

item.title: Where to Install Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Alarms
item.description: U.S. Fire Administration and EPA guidance on where smoke and CO alarms go, which types to buy, and when to test or replace them, room by room.

item.title: A Safety Checklist Before Any DIY Job
item.description: Official OSHA ladder safety guidance and EPA lead paint precautions, turned into a practical pre-project checklist for home DIY work.

item.title: Extension Cord Safety, How Not to Overload One
item.description: CPSC's official extension cord safety rules and fire statistics, with a simple wattage check to avoid overloading a cord during a weekend project.

item.title: How Much Paint You Actually Need
item.description: A step-by-step room paint quantity calculation using manufacturer coverage specs, so you buy the right number of gallons the first time.

item.title: Ladder Safety Basics Every Weekend DIYer Should Know
item.description: The core portable ladder safety rules from OSHA's official quick card, including the 3-point contact rule and the correct ladder setup angle.
